title: Set up your instance
subtitle: A few steps to create the first administrator and record the instance defaults.

token.label: Token
token.title: Prove you own this instance
token.description: The wizard is open to anyone who can reach this page. The boot token is what tells you apart from them.

admin.label: Administrator
admin.title: First administrator
admin.description: This account is an instance administrator. It follows the same rules as any other account.

settings.label: Defaults
settings.title: Instance defaults
settings.description: Applied to new accounts. Every one of these can be changed later.

email.label: Email
email.title: Outgoing email
email.description: Verification links and password resets go through this configuration.

token.label: Setup token
token.whereFrom: The backend prints it at startup — read the container logs:
token.logLine: Instance not set up yet. Open /setup and use token: …
token.envAlternative: If SETUP_TOKEN is set in the environment, that value is used instead.
token.hint: A restart issues a new token as long as the setup has not run.
token.invalid: Wrong token, or the setup has already run.

admin.emailHint: Marked as verified straight away — this is the address that recovers the instance.

settings.localeHint: Language of the interface for a new account.
settings.timezoneHint: Stored as an IANA identifier, so daylight saving is handled for you.
settings.publicSignupHint: When off, only an administrator can create accounts.
settings.hideLandingPageHint: When on, the landing page is hidden and the login page is shown instead. This is useful for instances that are not public-facing.

email.consoleWarning: The console backend writes mail to the process output — nothing is delivered. Verification links and password resets will not reach anyone. Fine for a local instance you are alone on, not for a shared one.
email.testSuccess: Sent. Check the inbox — including the spam folder.
email.testFailure: The email could not be sent.
email.continueAnywayHint: You can finish without a working email setup; fix it later in the environment file and restart.

completed.title: Instance configured.
completed.description: Sign in with the administrator account you just created.
